# Rules

These are all the rules adolint can report. Run `adolint explain <ID>` to see the same information in a terminal.

## Syntax and schema

| ID | Name | Default | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ADO001](ADO001/) | `yaml-syntax` | error | The file is not valid YAML. |
| [ADO002](ADO002/) | `duplicate-key` | error | A mapping defines the same key twice. |
| [ADO003](ADO003/) | `unknown-property` | error | A property is not allowed by the Azure Pipelines schema. |
| [ADO004](ADO004/) | `invalid-root` | error | The pipeline root mixes stages, jobs, steps or extends. |
| [ADO005](ADO005/) | `missing-required` | error | A required property is missing. |
| [ADO006](ADO006/) | `invalid-value` | error | A value has the wrong type or is not an allowed value. |
| [ADO007](ADO007/) | `deprecated-syntax` | warning | Deprecated syntax or a deprecated task version is used. |

## Structure and identity

| ID | Name | Default | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ADO101](ADO101/) | `invalid-identifier` | error | A stage or job name is not a valid identifier. |
| [ADO102](ADO102/) | `duplicate-name` | error | Two stages, jobs in a stage, or steps in a job share a name. |
| [ADO103](ADO103/) | `unknown-dependency` | error | dependsOn references a stage or job that doesn't exist. |
| [ADO104](ADO104/) | `dependency-cycle` | error | Stages or jobs depend on each other in a cycle. |
| [ADO105](ADO105/) | `task-version-missing` | error | A task reference has no major version. |

## Templates and parameters

| ID | Name | Default | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ADO201](ADO201/) | `invalid-template-reference` | error (off by default) | A local template can't be found or doesn't fit where it is used. |
| [ADO202](ADO202/) | `template-not-resolved` | info (off by default) | A template wasn't expanded, so its contents aren't linted. |
| [ADO203](ADO203/) | `unexpected-parameter` | error | A parameter is passed that the template doesn't declare. |
| [ADO204](ADO204/) | `missing-parameter` | error | A required template parameter is not passed. |
| [ADO205](ADO205/) | `parameter-value-invalid` | error | A parameter value doesn't match the declared type or allowed values. |
| [ADO206](ADO206/) | `undeclared-parameter-reference` | warning | An expression references a parameter the file doesn't declare. |
| [ADO207](ADO207/) | `unused-parameter` | info | A declared parameter is never used. |
| [ADO208](ADO208/) | `template-limits` | error | Template includes form a cycle or exceed documented limits. |

## Expressions

| ID | Name | Default | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ADO301](ADO301/) | `expression-syntax` | error | An expression or template directive is malformed. |
| [ADO302](ADO302/) | `invalid-function` | error | An unknown function is called, or a function has the wrong number of arguments. |
| [ADO303](ADO303/) | `runtime-expression-partial` | warning | A runtime expression $[ ] is mixed with other text. |
| [ADO304](ADO304/) | `template-expression-unsupported-location` | warning | ${{ }} is used where template expressions aren't expanded. |

## Best practices

| ID | Name | Default | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ADO401](ADO401/) | `implicit-ci-trigger` | warning | No trigger is defined, so CI runs for every branch. |
| [ADO402](ADO402/) | `implicit-pr-trigger` | info (off by default) | No pr trigger is defined, so PR validation runs for every branch. |
| [ADO403](ADO403/) | `hardcoded-secret` | warning | A secret-looking variable has a literal value. |
| [ADO404](ADO404/) | `retired-vm-image` | warning | A Microsoft-hosted image is retired or deprecated. |
| [ADO405](ADO405/) | `continue-on-error` | info (off by default) | continueOnError: true hides failures. |

## Tasks

| ID | Name | Default | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ADO501](ADO501/) | `unknown-task` | info | The task isn't a known built-in task or version. |
| [ADO502](ADO502/) | `invalid-task-input` | warning | A task input isn't defined for this built-in task version, or has a value outside its allowed list. |
| [ADO503](ADO503/) | `missing-task-input` | warning | A required input of a built-in task is missing. |

## Conditions

| ID | Name | Default | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ADO601](ADO601/) | `constant-condition` | warning | A condition is always true or always false. |
| [ADO602](ADO602/) | `constant-template-if` | warning | A ${{ if }} or ${{ elseif }} is always true or always false. |
| [ADO603](ADO603/) | `condition-overrides-succeeded` | warning | A custom condition doesn't check job status. |
| [ADO604](ADO604/) | `always-runs-on-cancel` | info | always() also runs when the run is canceled. |
| [ADO605](ADO605/) | `dependency-not-declared` | warning | dependencies.X is used without depending on X. |

## Scripts

| ID | Name | Default | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ADO701](ADO701/) | `shellcheck` | per finding (the tool's own severity) | ShellCheck finding in an inline bash script. |
| [ADO702](ADO702/) | `psscriptanalyzer` | per finding (the tool's own severity) | PSScriptAnalyzer finding in an inline PowerShell script. |
| [ADO703](ADO703/) | `script-linter-unavailable` | info | ShellCheck or PSScriptAnalyzer isn't installed, so scripts weren't linted. |
